name: Maya（舞夜）
description: Maya 原生日文形态键（ウィンク２、ジト目_L、口角上げL、瞳上 等）。眉毛键都是左右合一的。标了 guessed 的需要游戏实测。
description_en: Maya's native Japanese shape keys (ウィンク２, ジト目_L, 口角上げL, 瞳上, ...). The brow keys cover both sides. Mappings marked guessed need testing in game.

channels.name: 眉_上
channels.note: 眉毛上移；左右合一的键，左右信号各取一半。最大位移 12.6mm（maya）。整条眉毛上移。游戏动作表情由面部骨骼驱动：同时读骨骼信号 browRaise.L / browRaise.R，取较大者
channels.note_en: Brow up; one key for both sides, half of each side's signal. Max displacement 12.6 mm (maya). Whole brow up. Gameplay emotes move the face bones: also reads the bone signal browRaise.L / browRaise.R, the larger wins

channels.name: 眉_下
channels.note: 眉毛下压；左右合一的键，左右信号各取一半。最大位移 9.0mm（maya）。游戏动作表情由面部骨骼驱动：同时读骨骼信号 browLower.L / browLower.R，取较大者
channels.note_en: Brow down; one key for both sides, half of each side's signal. Max displacement 9.0 mm (maya). Gameplay emotes move the face bones: also reads the bone signal browLower.L / browLower.R, the larger wins

channels.name: 眉_斜め1
channels.note: 眉头上提；左右合一的键，左右信号各取一半。最大位移 6.4mm（maya）。眉_斜め1：眉头上提、眉尾下垂
channels.note_en: Inner brow up; one key for both sides, half of each side's signal. Max displacement 6.4 mm (maya). 眉_斜め1: inner brow up, outer brow down

channels.name: 怒り
channels.note: 眉头下压（皱眉）；左右合一的键，左右信号各取一半。最大位移 17.0mm（maya）。游戏动作表情由面部骨骼驱动：同时读骨骼信号 browInnerDown.L / browInnerDown.R，取较大者
channels.note_en: Inner brow down (frown); one key for both sides, half of each side's signal. Max displacement 17.0 mm (maya). Gameplay emotes move the face bones: also reads the bone signal browInnerDown.L / browInnerDown.R, the larger wins

channels.name: ウィンク２
channels.note: 闭眼（左侧）。最大位移 23.8mm（maya）。MMD 式单眼闭眼键：ウィンク２ 是角色左眼、ｳｨﾝｸ２右 是右眼（Blender 已确认）。游戏动作表情由面部骨骼驱动：同时读骨骼信号 eyeClose.L，取较大者
channels.note_en: Eye closed (left). Max displacement 23.8 mm (maya). MMD-style one-eye close keys: ウィンク２ is the character's left eye, ｳｨﾝｸ２右 the right (confirmed in Blender). Gameplay emotes move the face bones: also reads the bone signal eyeClose.L, the larger wins

channels.name: ｳｨﾝｸ２右
channels.note: 闭眼（右侧）。最大位移 23.8mm（maya）。MMD 式单眼闭眼键：ウィンク２ 是角色左眼、ｳｨﾝｸ２右 是右眼（Blender 已确认）。游戏动作表情由面部骨骼驱动：同时读骨骼信号 eyeClose.R，取较大者
channels.note_en: Eye closed (right). Max displacement 23.8 mm (maya). MMD-style one-eye close keys: ウィンク２ is the character's left eye, ｳｨﾝｸ２右 the right (confirmed in Blender). Gameplay emotes move the face bones: also reads the bone signal eyeClose.R, the larger wins

channels.name: おっとり_L
channels.note: 上眼睑下降、眼裂缩小（左侧）。最大位移 6.8mm（maya）。用おっとり（外侧上睑下垂）近似；ジト目_L 测得外侧上睑反而上移，没有使用
channels.note_en: Upper lid lowers, eye narrows (left). Max displacement 6.8 mm (maya). Approximated with おっとり (outer upper lid droops); ジト目_L measured with the outer upper lid moving up instead, not used

channels.name: おっとり_R
channels.note: 上眼睑下降、眼裂缩小（右侧）。最大位移 6.8mm（maya）。用おっとり（外侧上睑下垂）近似；ジト目_L 测得外侧上睑反而上移，没有使用
channels.note_en: Upper lid lowers, eye narrows (right). Max displacement 6.8 mm (maya). Approximated with おっとり (outer upper lid droops); ジト目_L measured with the outer upper lid moving up instead, not used

channels.name: びっくり_L
channels.note: 睁大眼（左侧）。最大位移 2.3mm（maya）。游戏动作表情由面部骨骼驱动：同时读骨骼信号 eyeWiden.L，取较大者
channels.note_en: Eye wide open (left). Max displacement 2.3 mm (maya). Gameplay emotes move the face bones: also reads the bone signal eyeWiden.L, the larger wins

channels.name: びっくり_R
channels.note: 睁大眼（右侧）。最大位移 2.3mm（maya）。游戏动作表情由面部骨骼驱动：同时读骨骼信号 eyeWiden.R，取较大者
channels.note_en: Eye wide open (right). Max displacement 2.3 mm (maya). Gameplay emotes move the face bones: also reads the bone signal eyeWiden.R, the larger wins

channels.name: 下まつ毛_上_L
channels.note: 下眼睑上提（笑眼下睑分量）（左侧）。最大位移 4.2mm（maya）。游戏动作表情由面部骨骼驱动：同时读骨骼信号 cheekRaise.L，取较大者
channels.note_en: Lower lid raised (the lower-lid part of a smiling eye) (left). Max displacement 4.2 mm (maya). Gameplay emotes move the face bones: also reads the bone signal cheekRaise.L, the larger wins

channels.name: 下まつ毛_上_R
channels.note: 下眼睑上提（笑眼下睑分量）（右侧）。最大位移 4.2mm（maya）。游戏动作表情由面部骨骼驱动：同时读骨骼信号 cheekRaise.R，取较大者
channels.note_en: Lower lid raised (the lower-lid part of a smiling eye) (right). Max displacement 4.2 mm (maya). Gameplay emotes move the face bones: also reads the bone signal cheekRaise.R, the larger wins

channels.name: ぷくー
channels.note: 脸颊鼓起；左右合一的键，左右信号各取一半。最大位移 4.2mm（maya）
channels.note_en: Cheek puffed; one key for both sides, half of each side's signal. Max displacement 4.2 mm (maya)

channels.name: あ
channels.note: 张嘴。最大位移 10.7mm（maya）。游戏动作表情由面部骨骼驱动：同时读骨骼信号 jawDrop，取较大者
channels.note_en: Mouth open. Max displacement 10.7 mm (maya). Gameplay emotes move the face bones: also reads the bone signal jawDrop, the larger wins

channels.name: う
channels.note: u 口型（嘴唇收拢）；左右合一的键，左右信号各取一半。最大位移 5.9mm（maya）
channels.note_en: "u" mouth shape (lips rounded); one key for both sides, half of each side's signal. Max displacement 5.9 mm (maya)

channels.name: 口角上げL
channels.note: 嘴角上扬（左侧）。最大位移 4.3mm（maya）。游戏动作表情由面部骨骼驱动：同时读骨骼信号 mouthCornerUp.L，取较大者
channels.note_en: Mouth corner up (left). Max displacement 4.3 mm (maya). Gameplay emotes move the face bones: also reads the bone signal mouthCornerUp.L, the larger wins

channels.name: 口角上げR
channels.note: 嘴角上扬（右侧）。最大位移 4.2mm（maya）。游戏动作表情由面部骨骼驱动：同时读骨骼信号 mouthCornerUp.R，取较大者
channels.note_en: Mouth corner up (right). Max displacement 4.2 mm (maya). Gameplay emotes move the face bones: also reads the bone signal mouthCornerUp.R, the larger wins

channels.name: 口角下げ
channels.note: 嘴角下垂；左右合一的键，左右信号各取一半。最大位移 1.8mm（maya）。游戏动作表情由面部骨骼驱动：同时读骨骼信号 mouthCornerDown.L / mouthCornerDown.R，取较大者
channels.note_en: Mouth corner down; one key for both sides, half of each side's signal. Max displacement 1.8 mm (maya). Gameplay emotes move the face bones: also reads the bone signal mouthCornerDown.L / mouthCornerDown.R, the larger wins

channels.name: 口_横幅1
channels.note: 嘴角向外、嘴变宽；左右合一的键，左右信号各取一半。最大位移 2.9mm（maya）。游戏动作表情由面部骨骼驱动：同时读骨骼信号 mouthCornerOut.L / mouthCornerOut.R，取较大者
channels.note_en: Mouth corner out, mouth wider; one key for both sides, half of each side's signal. Max displacement 2.9 mm (maya). Gameplay emotes move the face bones: also reads the bone signal mouthCornerOut.L / mouthCornerOut.R, the larger wins

channels.name: 口_横幅2
channels.note: 嘴角向内、嘴变窄；左右合一的键，左右信号各取一半。最大位移 4.1mm（maya）
channels.note_en: Mouth corner in, mouth narrower; one key for both sides, half of each side's signal. Max displacement 4.1 mm (maya)

channels.name: 口_上
channels.note: 嘴整体上移。最大位移 3.9mm（maya）
channels.note_en: Whole mouth up. Max displacement 3.9 mm (maya)

channels.name: 口_下
channels.note: 嘴整体下移。最大位移 5.7mm（maya）
channels.note_en: Whole mouth down. Max displacement 5.7 mm (maya)

channels.name: 瞳上
channels.note: 虹膜上移。最大位移 6.4mm（maya）。视线方向按 Shinano 游戏实测换算：虹膜移向角色自身左侧(+X) 对应 yaw +1。
channels.note_en: Iris up. Max displacement 6.4 mm (maya). Gaze direction converted as measured in game on Shinano: iris toward the character's own left (+X) = yaw +1.

channels.name: 瞳下
channels.note: 虹膜下移。最大位移 4.0mm（maya）。视线方向按 Shinano 游戏实测换算：虹膜移向角色自身左侧(+X) 对应 yaw +1。
channels.note_en: Iris down. Max displacement 4.0 mm (maya). Gaze direction converted as measured in game on Shinano: iris toward the character's own left (+X) = yaw +1.

channels.name: 瞳左
channels.note: 虹膜移向角色左侧。最大位移 2.2mm（maya）。视线方向按 Shinano 游戏实测换算：虹膜移向角色自身左侧(+X) 对应 yaw +1。
channels.note_en: Iris to the character's left. Max displacement 2.2 mm (maya). Gaze direction converted as measured in game on Shinano: iris toward the character's own left (+X) = yaw +1.

channels.name: 瞳右
channels.note: 虹膜移向角色右侧。最大位移 2.1mm（maya）。视线方向按 Shinano 游戏实测换算：虹膜移向角色自身左侧(+X) 对应 yaw +1。
channels.note_en: Iris to the character's right. Max displacement 2.1 mm (maya). Gaze direction converted as measured in game on Shinano: iris toward the character's own left (+X) = yaw +1.

channels.name: ウィンク
channels.note: 笑眼（^^）：下眼睑上提 × 同侧嘴角上扬，开心 1 多在 0.3–0.5、开心 2 约 0.75；战吼眯眼时没有笑，不会触发
channels.note_en: Smiling eyes (^^): lower lid lift × that side's mouth corner up, mostly 0.3-0.5 in happy 1 and about 0.75 in happy 2; the battle cry squint has no smile, so it does not fire

channels.name: ウィンク右
channels.note: 笑眼（^^）：下眼睑上提 × 同侧嘴角上扬，开心 1 多在 0.3–0.5、开心 2 约 0.75；战吼眯眼时没有笑，不会触发
channels.note_en: Smiling eyes (^^): lower lid lift × that side's mouth corner up, mostly 0.3-0.5 in happy 1 and about 0.75 in happy 2; the battle cry squint has no smile, so it does not fire

channels.name: い
channels.note: 嘴角几乎完全向外时张开成露齿笑：左右嘴角向外的平均值过 0.6 后线性到 0.5（开心 2）
channels.note_en: Opens into a toothy grin once the corners are almost fully outward: the left / right outward average past 0.6, linear up to 0.5 (happy 2)
